description: End-to-end workflow for automated and human-assisted moderation, review, and lifecycle management of network intelligence findings (anomalies, alerts, policy violations) in a TaaS environment.

finding_id.description: Unique identifier for a network intelligence finding (alert, anomaly, policy violation).

review_session_id.description: Identifier for a moderation/review session that groups multiple findings and reviewer actions.

policy_id.description: Identifier of a moderation or correlation policy applied to findings.

network_scope.description: Common representation of the network scope for which findings are being managed.

segments.description: Network segment identifiers (e.g., VLANs, VRFs, zones).

device_filters.description: Optional filters narrowing down devices within the network.

items.description: Router, switch, firewall, load_balancer, host, etc.

review_decision.description: Standardized structure of a moderation decision for a finding.

reason.description: Free-form explanation or justification for the decision.

labels.description: Labels applied to the finding for future learning or workflows.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: search_findings
functions.description: Search and filter network intelligence findings needing moderation or review.

scope.description: Network scope in which to search for findings.

filters.description: Filter criteria for narrowing down findings.

relative.description: Relative time window, alternative to from/to.

items.description: Source of the finding, e.g., nids, siem, telemetry_analytics.

text_query.description: Free-text search over finding descriptions and metadata.

labels.description: Match findings that have all of the specified labels.

functions.returns: Paginated list of findings matching the criteria, including summary metadata (finding_id, type, severity, timestamps, brief description).

functions.name: get_finding_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details, context, and enrichment for a specific finding.

include.description: Optional sections to include for deeper analysis.

redaction.description: PII and sensitive data redaction options for human review.

functions.returns: Comprehensive finding object including metadata, context graphs, raw/correlated events, and optionally similar findings and recommendations.

functions.name: start_review_session
functions.description: Create a new moderation/review session that groups one or more findings for a reviewer or automated process.

id.description: User ID, system ID, or integration ID.

finding_ids.description: Initial set of findings to attach to the review session.

auto_discovery.description: Optional automatic selection of findings based on rules.

criteria.description: Selection criteria similar to search filters.

workflow_policies.description: Moderation workflow policies to apply during this session.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for the session.

functions.returns: Review session ID, initial status, and the resolved list of associated findings.

functions.name: assign_review_session
functions.description: Assign or reassign a review session to a human reviewer, team, or automated queue.

id.description: ID of the user, group, queue, or automation profile.

routing_reason.description: Reason for assignment or reassignment (e.g., escalated severity, workload balance).

functions.returns: Assignment confirmation with updated assignee, timestamps, and any notification delivery results.

functions.name: evaluate_finding_automated
functions.description: Run automated analysis and policy evaluation on a finding to propose a moderation decision.

policy_bundle.description: Set of policies and models to apply for automated evaluation.

ml_models.description: Machine learning models or profiles to use.

context_expansion.description: Options controlling which additional context to fetch during automated evaluation.

dry_run.description: If true, only propose a decision without updating finding state.

functions.returns: Proposed automated review_decision with confidence scores, contributing evidence, and explanation details; optionally updated finding state if not dry_run.

functions.name: submit_review_decision
functions.description: Submit a human or automated moderation decision for a specific finding, optionally as part of a review session.

actor.description: Entity issuing the decision.

execution_plan.description: Plan for how enforcement actions should be carried out.

targets.description: Specific network entities targeted by enforcement.

constraints.description: Guardrails for the enforcement, such as max bandwidth limit or TTL.

content.description: Opaque content or URL, depending on attachment type.

functions.returns: Updated finding review state, audit log entry ID, and, if applicable, an enforcement job ID for follow-up.

functions.name: apply_moderation_action
functions.description: Execute or simulate enforcement actions derived from a moderation decision on the underlying network resources.

enforcement_job_id.description: Optional pre-created enforcement job identifier; if not provided, a new job is created from the latest decision.

mode.description: Whether to actually enforce, simulate, or rollback a previous enforcement.

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides for enforcement parameters like duration or scope.

items.description: Target identifiers to exclude from enforcement.

functions.returns: Enforcement job status, list of operations performed or simulated, and any safety check violations or rollback results.

functions.name: get_review_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current review and enforcement status for a finding or entire review session.

include_timelines.description: If true, include event timelines and decision history.

include_metrics.description: If true, include aggregated metrics for the session or finding.

functions.returns: Current review state, moderation decisions, enforcement jobs, and optionally timelines and aggregated metrics for the requested entity.

functions.name: retry_automated_review
functions.description: Retry automated evaluation for findings that previously failed, timed out, or had low confidence.

finding_ids.description: Specific findings to retry, or leave empty to select by criteria.

retry_filters.description: Criteria for selecting which findings to retry.

override_policy_bundle.description: Optional simplified policy bundle override for retries.

functions.returns: Batch retry job summary including counts of retried findings, successes, failures, and per-finding retry results.

functions.name: rollback_moderation_decision
functions.description: Rollback a prior moderation decision and optionally revert any associated enforcement actions.

decision_id.description: Identifier of the decision to rollback; if omitted, the latest decision is targeted.

reason.description: Explanation for the rollback, stored in audit logs.

dry_run.description: If true, show what would be rolled back without performing changes.

functions.returns: Rollback plan or execution result, including which decisions/enforcements were affected and any conflicts encountered.

functions.name: cancel_review_session
functions.description: Cancel an in-progress review session and optionally revert pending decisions or enforcement plans.

cancel_mode.description: Soft retains decisions already committed; hard attempts to rollback pending ones.

affect_findings.description: Configure whether attached findings should change state.

functions.returns: Session cancellation confirmation with list of affected findings and any rollbacks performed.

functions.name: list_review_sessions
functions.description: List and filter review sessions for monitoring workload, audit, or reporting.
functions.returns: Paginated list of review sessions with metadata (review_session_id, status, counts of findings by decision, assignee, timestamps).

functions.name: summarize_review_outcomes
functions.description: Generate an analytical summary of moderation outcomes over a time window for reporting and tuning.

group_by.description: Dimensions to group summary metrics by.

functions.returns: Aggregated statistics of review outcomes structured per requested grouping and format, suitable for dashboards or exports.

functions.name: search_findings_2
functions.description: Faceted search across finding records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for network_review_moderation_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of finding records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_findings_by_status
functions.description: List finding records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of finding records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_finding_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single finding record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A finding record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_findings
functions.description: Submit a batch of finding records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_findings
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many finding records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_findings
functions.description: Soft-archive finding records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_findings
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of finding records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_finding_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for finding lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_finding_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created finding event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_finding_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a finding including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_finding_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for network_review_moderation_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_finding_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a network_review_moderation_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_finding_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled network_review_moderation_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_finding_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a network_review_moderation_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_finding_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a finding prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_finding_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a finding for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_finding_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending finding approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_finding
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached finding to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_finding_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a finding.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_finding_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a finding with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_finding_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a finding and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_finding_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a finding (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_finding_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for network_review_moderation_flow over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_finding_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for network_review_moderation_flow.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_finding_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed network_review_moderation_flow behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_finding_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active network_review_moderation_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.name: link_finding_dependencies
functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a finding and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Resulting link set with created, updated, and removed entries.
